_doc: One entry per army in data.js. Adding an army = one entry here; no source script names an army.

wahapedia: faction codes in the Wahapedia CSV export (Datasheets.csv column 3). List the army's own code first; add a shared code (CD = Chaos Daemons, AoI = Agents of the Imperium) only when the army's units or rules live there.
bsdata: catalogue file names in BSData/wh40k-11e that hold the army's units and rules (include its Library file if it has one).

packVersion: the newest official Faction Pack version. wahapediaVersion: the version the Wahapedia export carries. When they differ, Wahapedia lags and BSData text wins where the two disagree (status PACK_AHEAD, reviewed by hand).
